environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (3) a custom regex-based rule with priority 0 that inspects the URI query string component using a RegexPatternSet matching pattern `(?i)(?:'|%27|--|%23|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|;|\x00|%00)` with action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint (enforced via VPC security group on the task ENI allowing only outbound to port 5432 on the RDS SG), preventing DNS-based or HTTP-based out-of-band data exfiltration even if blind SQLi were somehow attempted through an encoding bypass.
